changelog: Redesigned audio quality tiers with small spec pills (bitrate, resolution, WIFI/DATA).
Hi-Res Audio and CD Lossless stream FLAC from a connected hifi-api/Tidal server.
Standard Quality streams 320 kbps from a connected 320 kbps/HiFi server.
Auto now uses Hi-Res on Wi-Fi and a balanced stream on mobile data.
Server-only quality tiers are hidden until a server is connected, and fall back safely if it's removed.
Added a Sync section with YouTube Music history, hidden while using a Local Profile.
